en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest harbor or quay. In the foreground is a grassy and rocky shoreline leading to calm water with stones scattered near the shore. Across the water stands a low pier with wooden warehouses or sheds, small boats and masts visible. Forested land extends along the background horizon. The caption "Lovisa; Tullbron." is printed in small red letters in the upper left corner.
